appUrl.title: appUrl
appUrl.description:
appUrl is the external/public URL of the BookOrbit instance (required). Used by
emails and Kobo endpoints.

clientUrl.title: clientUrl
clientUrl.description:
clientUrl is the CORS origin for the frontend, when served from a different domain
than appUrl. Defaults to appUrl when empty.

APP_URL.title: APP_URL
APP_URL.description:
Public URL of the BookOrbit instance, templated from the top-level
appUrl value.

BOOKORBIT_FIX_PERMISSIONS.title: BOOKORBIT_FIX_PERMISSIONS
BOOKORBIT_FIX_PERMISSIONS.description:
Whether the BookOrbit entrypoint fixes ownership/permissions on its
data directories at startup.

CLIENT_URL.title: CLIENT_URL
CLIENT_URL.description:
CORS origin for the frontend, templated from the top-level clientUrl
value (falling back to appUrl).

CSP_ALLOW_CLOUDFLARE_INSIGHTS.title: CSP_ALLOW_CLOUDFLARE_INSIGHTS
CSP_ALLOW_CLOUDFLARE_INSIGHTS.description:
Relaxes the Content-Security-Policy to allow loading Cloudflare
Insights analytics scripts.

key.title: key
key.description: Key within the Secret that holds the email encryption key.

name.title: name
name.description:
Name of the Secret holding the email encryption key, templated
from the top-level secretName value.

optional.title: optional
optional.description:
When true, BookOrbit starts even if this key is absent from the
Secret, instead of failing to schedule the pod.

secretKeyRef.title: secretKeyRef
secretKeyRef.description: References an optional key within an existing Secret.

valueFrom.title: valueFrom
valueFrom.description:
Sources the email encryption key from a Secret key rather than a
literal value.

EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description:
EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY encrypts stored email-related credentials (e.g.
for outbound mail integrations). Optional; sourced from the
`email-encryption-key` key of the Secret named by secretName, if
present.

key.title: key
key.description: Key within the Secret that holds the JWT signing secret.

name.title: name
name.description:
Name of the Secret holding the JWT signing secret, templated
from the top-level secretName value.

secretKeyRef.title: secretKeyRef
secretKeyRef.description: References a key within an existing Secret.

valueFrom.title: valueFrom
valueFrom.description:
Sources the JWT signing secret from a Secret key rather than a
literal value.

JWT_SECRET.title: JWT_SECRET
JWT_SECRET.description:
JWT_SECRET is the signing secret BookOrbit uses for session/auth
tokens, sourced from the `jwt-secret` key of the Secret named by
secretName.

key.title: key
key.description: Key within the Secret that holds the migration encryption key.

name.title: name
name.description:
Name of the Secret holding the migration encryption key,
templated from the top-level secretName value.

optional.title: optional
optional.description:
When true, BookOrbit starts even if this key is absent from the
Secret, instead of failing to schedule the pod.

secretKeyRef.title: secretKeyRef
secretKeyRef.description: References an optional key within an existing Secret.

valueFrom.title: valueFrom
valueFrom.description:
Sources the migration encryption key from a Secret key rather than
a literal value.

MIGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.title: MIGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY
MIGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description:
MIGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY is used when migrating/decrypting data
encrypted by a previous encryption key. Optional; sourced from the
`migration-encryption-key` key of the Secret named by secretName, if
present.

NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE.title: NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE
NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_SIZE.description:
Sets Node.js's --max-old-space-size for the BookOrbit process, in
megabytes. "auto" lets the application derive a value from available
memory.

OIDC_ALLOW_LOCAL_ISSUERS.title: OIDC_ALLOW_LOCAL_ISSUERS
OIDC_ALLOW_LOCAL_ISSUERS.description:
Allows OIDC issuers that resolve to local/private network addresses.
Useful for self-hosted identity providers running inside the cluster
or LAN; leave disabled unless you need this.

PORT.title: PORT
PORT.description:
TCP port the BookOrbit server listens on inside the container. Must
match service.main.ports.http.port when changed.

POSTGRES_DB.title: POSTGRES_DB
POSTGRES_DB.description:
PostgreSQL database name passed to BookOrbit, templated from
database.name.

POSTGRES_HOST.title: POSTGRES_HOST
POSTGRES_HOST.description: PostgreSQL hostname passed to BookOrbit, templated from database.host.

key.title: key
key.description:
Key within the Secret that holds the PostgreSQL password,
templated from database.existingSecretPasswordKey.

name.title: name
name.description:
Name of the Secret holding the PostgreSQL password, templated
from database.existingSecret.

secretKeyRef.title: secretKeyRef
secretKeyRef.description: References a key within an existing Secret.

valueFrom.title: valueFrom
valueFrom.description:
Sources the PostgreSQL password from a Secret key rather than a
literal value.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.title: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description:
POSTGRES_PASSWORD is the password BookOrbit uses to authenticate to
PostgreSQL, sourced from database.existingSecret /
database.existingSecretPasswordKey.

POSTGRES_PORT.title: POSTGRES_PORT
POSTGRES_PORT.description: PostgreSQL port passed to BookOrbit, templated from database.port.

POSTGRES_USER.title: POSTGRES_USER
POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL username passed to BookOrbit, templated from database.user.

key.title: key
key.description: Key within the Secret that holds the setup bootstrap token.

name.title: name
name.description:
Name of the Secret holding the setup bootstrap token, templated
from the top-level secretName value.

secretKeyRef.title: secretKeyRef
secretKeyRef.description: References a key within an existing Secret.

valueFrom.title: valueFrom
valueFrom.description:
Sources the setup bootstrap token from a Secret key rather than a
literal value.

SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.title: SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN
SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description:
SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN is a one-time token used to authorize initial
instance setup (e.g. creating the first admin account), sourced from
the `setup-bootstrap-token` key of the Secret named by secretName.

env.title: env
env.description:
env sets environment variables passed to the BookOrbit container. Most
entries below configure the application directly; a few use
`valueFrom.secretKeyRef` to source sensitive values from an existing
Secret (see `secretName` and `database.existingSecret` above) instead of
embedding them in values.yaml.

pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy
pullPolicy.description: Kubernetes image pull policy for the BookOrbit image.

repository.title: repository
repository.description: Container image repository for the BookOrbit application.

tag.title: tag
tag.description:
Unlike `helm create`-based charts, app-template does not fall back to
Chart.appVersion automatically — the tag must be set explicitly.

image.title: image
image.description: image identifies the container image to run for BookOrbit.

path.title: path
path.description: HTTP path checked for the liveness probe.

type.title: type
type.description: Probe mechanism used for the liveness check.

liveness.title: liveness
liveness.description: liveness restarts the container if BookOrbit stops responding.

path.title: path
path.description: HTTP path checked for the readiness probe.

type.title: type
type.description: Probe mechanism used for the readiness check.

readiness.title: readiness
readiness.description:
readiness gates whether the pod receives traffic from the Service
based on BookOrbit's health.

probes.title: probes
probes.description:
probes configures the liveness and readiness checks the kubelet uses to
monitor the BookOrbit container.

memory.title: memory
memory.description:
Maximum memory the BookOrbit container may use before being OOM
killed. No CPU limit is set, so CPU usage is not throttled.

limits.title: limits
limits.description: limits cap the resources the container may consume.

cpu.title: cpu
cpu.description: Minimum CPU guaranteed to the BookOrbit container.

memory.title: memory
memory.description: Minimum memory guaranteed to the BookOrbit container.

requests.title: requests
requests.description: requests are the minimum resources guaranteed to the container.

resources.title: resources
resources.description:
resources sets CPU/memory requests and limits for the BookOrbit
container.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.title: allowPrivilegeEscalation
allowPrivilegeEscalation.description:
Prevents the container process from gaining more privileges than its
parent process.

drop.title: drop
drop.description:
Linux capabilities to remove from the container process. Dropping ALL
follows the principle of least privilege.

capabilities.title: capabilities
capabilities.description:
capabilities adjusts the Linux kernel capabilities granted to the
container process.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.title: readOnlyRootFilesystem
readOnlyRootFilesystem.description:
Whether the container's root filesystem is mounted read-only. BookOrbit
needs to write outside of the data/books volumes, so this stays false.

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description:
securityContext restricts the privileges available to the BookOrbit
container process.

main.title: main
main.description: main is the BookOrbit application container.

containers.title: containers
containers.description: containers lists the containers that make up the main controller's pod.

fsGroup.title: fsGroup
fsGroup.description:
GID applied to mounted volumes (data/books PVCs) so the non-root process
can read and write them.

runAsGroup.title: runAsGroup
runAsGroup.description: GID the BookOrbit container process runs as.

runAsNonRoot.title: runAsNonRoot
runAsNonRoot.description: Requires the pod's containers to run as a non-root user.

runAsUser.title: runAsUser
runAsUser.description: UID the BookOrbit container process runs as.

type.title: type
type.description: Uses the container runtime's default seccomp profile.

seccompProfile.title: seccompProfile
seccompProfile.description: seccompProfile restricts the set of syscalls available to the container.

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description:
The image's entrypoint chowns /data to PUID:PGID (default 1000:1000) when
started as root, but runs equally well started directly as non-root, which
is what fsGroup + runAsUser do here.

pod.title: pod
pod.description:
pod holds Pod-level settings (as opposed to container-level) for the main
controller, such as the shared securityContext below.

replicas.title: replicas
replicas.description:
BookOrbit keeps book files and app data on ReadWriteOnce PVCs, so this must
stay at 1. Scaling beyond 1 replica risks two pods writing the same library
concurrently.

strategy.title: strategy
strategy.description:
Deployment update strategy. Recreate is required because the RWO data/books
PVCs cannot be attached to two pods at once during a rolling update.

type.title: type
type.description: Kind of Kubernetes workload controller to render for the main controller.

main.title: main
main.description: main is the primary (and only) BookOrbit workload.

controllers.title: controllers
controllers.description:
controllers defines the workloads (Deployments/StatefulSets/etc.) managed by the
bjw-s common library chart. BookOrbit runs a single controller named `main`.

existingSecret.title: existingSecret
existingSecret.description: existingSecret names a pre-existing Secret holding the database password.

existingSecretPasswordKey.title: existingSecretPasswordKey
existingSecretPasswordKey.description: existingSecretPasswordKey is the key within existingSecret that holds the password.

host.title: host
host.description: Hostname or address of the external PostgreSQL server.

name.title: name
name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database BookOrbit connects to.

port.title: port
port.description: TCP port the external PostgreSQL server listens on.

user.title: user
user.description: Username BookOrbit uses to authenticate to PostgreSQL.

database.title: database
database.description:
database configures the connection to an external PostgreSQL instance. This chart
does not deploy PostgreSQL. The instance must have the uuid-ossp, pg_trgm, and
vector (pgvector) extensions available, e.g. pgvector/pgvector:pg18.

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description:
Arbitrary annotations to add to the Ingress resource, e.g. for
cert-manager or ingress-controller-specific behavior.

className.title: className
className.description:
IngressClass to use. Leave empty to use the cluster's default
IngressClass.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Enables creation of the Ingress resource.

hosts.title: hosts
hosts.description:
List of hostnames (and their path routing rules) the Ingress should
accept traffic for.

tls.title: tls
tls.description:
TLS configuration blocks for the Ingress, pairing hostnames with the
Secret containing their certificate.

main.title: main
main.description: main is the Ingress resource exposing BookOrbit outside the cluster.

ingress.title: ingress
ingress.description:
ingress.main is disabled by default. See
https://bjw-s-labs.github.io/helm-charts/docs/app-template/reference/ingress/

accessMode.title: accessMode
accessMode.description: Access mode requested for the PVC.

existingClaim.title: existingClaim
existingClaim.description:
Name of a pre-existing PVC to use instead of letting the chart create one.
Leave empty to have the chart provision and manage the PVC.

forceRename.title: forceRename
forceRename.description:
Pins the books PVC to a specific name instead of the chart's auto-derived
one. See persistence.data.forceRename above for why this exists.

globalMounts.title: globalMounts
globalMounts.description: Paths inside the main container where this volume is mounted.

size.title: size
size.description: Size of the PVC to provision for BookOrbit's book library.

storageClass.title: storageClass
storageClass.description:
StorageClass requested for the PVC. Leave empty to use the cluster's
default StorageClass.

type.title: type
type.description: Kind of volume source backing this persistence entry.

books.title: books
books.description: books backs the library folder mounted at /books.

accessMode.title: accessMode
accessMode.description: Access mode requested for the PVC.

existingClaim.title: existingClaim
existingClaim.description:
Name of a pre-existing PVC to use instead of letting the chart create one.
Leave empty to have the chart provision and manage the PVC.

forceRename.title: forceRename
forceRename.description:
forceRename pins the PVC to a specific name instead of the chart's
auto-derived one. Needed when other persistence entries are added/removed,
since that shifts the auto-derived name and Helm would otherwise delete and
recreate the PVC under the new name (PVC names are immutable).

globalMounts.title: globalMounts
globalMounts.description: Paths inside the main container where this volume is mounted.

size.title: size
size.description:
Size of the PVC to provision for BookOrbit's app data (covers, book
bucket, DB migration state).

storageClass.title: storageClass
storageClass.description:
StorageClass requested for the PVC. Leave empty to use the cluster's
default StorageClass.

type.title: type
type.description: Kind of volume source backing this persistence entry.

data.title: data
data.description:
data backs APP_DATA_PATH (/data), covering covers, book-bucket, and DB
migration state.

persistence.title: persistence
persistence.description:
persistence defines the PersistentVolumeClaims (or other volume sources)
mounted into the main controller.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Enables creation of the HTTPRoute resource.

hostnames.title: hostnames
hostnames.description: Hostnames the route matches incoming requests against.

kind.title: kind
kind.description: Gateway API route kind to create.

parentRefs.title: parentRefs
parentRefs.description:
References to the Gateway(s) this route attaches to. This chart does not
create the Gateway itself.

main.title: main
main.description:
main is the Gateway API HTTPRoute exposing BookOrbit outside the cluster, as
an alternative to ingress.main.

route.title: route
route.description:
route.main is the Gateway API HTTPRoute alternative to ingress.main, disabled by
default. Set parentRefs to attach to an existing Gateway (this chart does not
create one — Gateways are platform infrastructure, provisioned separately). A
ReferenceGrant is generated automatically if the route ends up in a different
namespace than this release. See
https://bjw-s-labs.github.io/helm-charts/docs/app-template/reference/route/

secretName.title: secretName
secretName.description:
secretName names a pre-existing Secret (e.g. created by an ExternalSecret) holding
jwt-secret and setup-bootstrap-token, and optionally email-encryption-key /
migration-encryption-key.

controller.title: controller
controller.description: Name of the controller this Service routes traffic to.

port.title: port
port.description:
Port the Service listens on and forwards to the container's PORT env
var.

primary.title: primary
primary.description:
Marks this as the Service's primary port, used e.g. as the default for
ingress/route backends.

http.title: http
http.description: http is the port serving the BookOrbit web application and API.

ports.title: ports
ports.description: ports lists the ports exposed by this Service.

main.title: main
main.description: main is the primary Service, routing traffic to the main controller.

service.title: service
service.description:
service defines the Kubernetes Services fronting the controllers. BookOrbit
exposes a single Service named `main`.
